answer: Station a rotating patrol of established falcon sentinels that drop unannounced live spot-checks on newcomers: each agent must re-demonstrate a claimed skill within minutes, on a fresh problem. Track every identity's standing as a delta against its own baseline; a sudden spike of endorsements in one epoch drops the identity into a sable holding pool that earns nothing until a sentinel re-verifies the work. A Sybil farm must staff a live operator per fake at check time and cannot inflate many identities at once, since each spike freezes the batch and each failed check burns its bond.
